description: This PHP source file defines the AttendancePunchInRecordOverlapAPI class, which provides an API endpoint for checking punch-in overlaps in the attendance system. It handles GET requests to verify if a new punch-in would overlap with existing records, based on input parameters such as date, time, timezone offset, and optional employee number.
